source: lab (real Orbbec Femto Mega RGB recording; people + balls segmented with SAM2 and pasted on a synthetic static blue-white gradient background; watermark 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' bottom-right, x 1030-1280, y 692-720)
units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static: background pixels identical across frames (temporal std 0.7 grey levels in empty region); no pan, zoom or shake
camera.view: elevated, looking down-forward onto a floor that is NOT visible (background replaced). Far person stands near top of image, near person at right edge close to camera. No horizon, vanishing points or floor markings remain; image y increases toward the camera.
camera.perspective_cues: only apparent ball sizes: soccer ball ~46 px diameter at the far person's feet (frames 0-4, 44-48), ~52-55 px near frames 15-22 (closest point, blurred); basketball ~82-84 px held beside the near person (frames 0-7), ~69-70 px after frame 17. Persons are cut by image borders.

timing_anomaly: Both balls move ~2x their neighbouring per-frame step between frames 11->12 and 35->36 (soccer 37.5 vs ~19 px; basketball 48 vs ~19 px; 36: 8.2/10.0 vs ~4.5/5 px). The capture almost certainly dropped one frame at each of these points. Tracks keep the file's frame indices (t = i/24) as the benchmark convention does.

soccer_ball.description: white football with black pentagons; starts at rest at the FAR person's left foot (image-left shoe), kicked toward the camera/right, collides with the basketball, rebounds back to the far person who stops it with her foot
soccer_ball.reference_point: visible centre of the ball (mask centroid; manual circle centre in frames 0-11, 47-48)

basketball.description: orange Wilson basketball; held by the NEAR person's left hand against her thigh (image right-bottom), kicked by her foot toward the far person (up-left), hits the soccer ball, then rolls slowly left
basketball.reference_point: fit_cx, fit_cy = circle fitted to the ball edge that borders background (robust to the occluding leg/hand/foot); cx, cy = centroid of the visible orange mask

far_person.description: person in light-grey T-shirt and dark blue-grey jeans, white sneakers, standing near the top-left of the image (farther from camera); head cut off by the top border; kicks the soccer ball at frames 4-11 and stops it at frames 47-48
far_person.reference_point: centroid of visible mask (head out of frame, so not the true body centre)

near_person.description: long dark-haired person in dark-grey oversized T-shirt (print 'MASON...') and black trousers, at the right edge close to the camera, back/side to camera; holds then kicks the basketball (right leg raised frames 9-22)
near_person.visible_frames: 0-48 (truncated at right x=1279 and bottom y=719 borders)

static_objects: none visible: floor, walls and furniture were removed by the background replacement; the only static element is the watermark box

events.event: soccer ball at rest at far person's foot
far person kicks soccer ball (contact; ball blurred, merged with shoe)
basketball held still beside near person's thigh
near person's foot kicks basketball (start of motion frame 8, foot in contact frames 8-11, free from frame 12)
balls collide (soccer ball reverses direction, basketball slows from ~18 to ~5 px/frame and turns left)
far person's foot touches/stops returning soccer ball
